//: Solution file: `tsc -b` builds every referenced project. Each package adds its reference in the stage that creates it (plan 001); the first is packages/proto at v0.1.2, which is also when `pnpm typecheck` becomes a real CI gate — tsc refuses an empty solution (TS18002), and a gate with nothing to check gates nothing.

apps/web is deliberately absent and stays absent: SvelteKit generates its own tsconfig, and tsc does not read .svelte script blocks at all. That surface belongs to svelte-check (`pnpm check`, CI from v0.1.6).
